decisions.decision: Remove the word "may" from item 19 of the RFP scope of services and combine items 19 and 21 into one line item.

decisions.decision: Board of Assessors should not vote on Chapter Land applications until a site inspection is done after the completed chapter application is received.
decisions.quote: she suggest once we have the completed chapter application, the boa should not vote until a site inspection has been done.
